scope: OAuth, native credential persistence, and account command implementation

source.note: State at validation time, before the implementation and handoff commit. Validation includes local branch, release, secret and variable changes. The base revision alone does not reproduce the validated working tree.

isolated_release_binary_smoke.environment: empty inherited environment, isolated temporary HOME and GH_CONFIG_DIR

portable_regression_earlier_in_this_slic.note: Subsequent persistence changes are confined to the native package. These portable counts are regression checks, not native OAuth implementation coverage.
